content.text:
OpenFlowsheet 0.2.0a2 can't represent this case, so I built nothing and ran no solve. I made no substitute.

The case needs a `DistillationColumn` (T101) with a reflux return, a reboiler vapor return and overhead and bottoms draws. The model list has no staged column or any unit that does the same job. It offers only mixers, splitters, TP flashes, heaters, a heat exchanger, a pump, a valve, reactors, a component separator, feed sources and product sinks. A single flash or a component separator isn't a column, so using one would change what the case simulates.

The case's property package is `native_pyomo_conservation_model`, covering TEG, H2O, CH4 and BTEX in liquid, vapor and solid phases. It isn't a property route this version exposes. I didn't commit a draft revision to test whether the four components are available, so I'm not claiming a component limitation.

```json
{"case_id": "variant_idaes_teg_regenerator_stripping_column", "status": "limitation", "revision_id": null, "job_id": null, "limitation": {"reasons": [{"kind": "unit_unavailable", "subject": "DistillationColumn"}, {"kind": "property_route_unavailable", "subject": "process_extension"}], "explanation": "The model catalogue has no multistage distillation column, which T101 needs for its reflux, boil-up, overhead and bottoms connections. It also has no property route matching the case's native_pyomo_conservation_model package (TEG/H2O/CH4/BTEX, Liq/Vap/Sol). A single flash or component separator would not do what the column does, so no substitute was built."}, "claims": []}
```
